calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor for an ASE atoms structure using pymatgen and an ASE calculator
compute_bulk_modulus: compute the bulk modulus VRH average from an elastic tensor calculation on a crystal structure
compute_shear_modulus: compute the shear modulus VRH average from an elastic tensor calculation on a crystal structure
run_elasticity_with_relaxation: run elasticity calculations with initial and strained structure relaxation using custom strain values
calculate_elasticity_without_equilibrium: calculate elasticity results without using equilibrium stress for unrelaxed structures
